content: आह्वानम् .²1 Calling, inviting. .²2 A call, invitation, summons (in general); सुहृदाह्वानं प्रकुर्वीत <ls>Pt. 3. 47</ls>. .²3 A legal summons (from court or govt. to appear before a tribunal); <ls>Mk. 9</ls>. .²4 Invocation of a deity; जन्मज्येष्ठेन चाह्वानं सुब्रह्मण्यास्वपि स्मृतम् <ls>Ms. 9. 126</ls>. .²5 A challenge. .²6 A name, appellation. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of a liturgical formula.
